job: Upload and schedule prepared vertical educational videos to a confirmed TikTok Studio account.
real_inputs: Local MP4 files, an explicit posting order, caption/topic text, schedule slots, and optional music rotation.
primary_output: Scheduled TikTok posts plus an auditable local publish log with filename, track, volume, caption, and schedule.
description: Upload and schedule short educational videos in the user-confirmed TikTok Studio session, with verified captions, rotated low-volume platform music, and a publish audit; do not edit media or delete posts.
exclusions: Do not edit videos, generate media, choose an unconfirmed browser/account, or delete existing posts.
constraints: Preserve original audio; add platform music at about -40 dB; rotate tracks; verify the post row after submission.
standards: Never claim success without a visible post-row or schedule confirmation.
correction: Stop on wrong window, missing account, loud music, caption persistence failure, or ambiguous schedule state and report the exact checkpoint.
